## Concepts

- Open Access
  - "Ensures that research publications are freely and openly available online, enabling widespread access to evidence-based knowledge. Any use or reuse of open access content is still subject to full and proper attribution and will have an appropriate license" - <https://www.crkn-rcdr.ca/en/open-access>
- Open Source
- Metadata
- License (as a verb, providing access to ejournals, databases, etc)
- Creative Commons License
  - Open license run by a non-profit group that allows sharing of knowledge in the public domain. <https://creativecommons.org/what-we-do/>
- Trustworthy Digital Repository (TDR)
- COUNTER usage statistics
- Peer review
- SAFES Data
- FAIR Principles
- CARE Principles - Collective benefit, Authority to control, Responsibility, Ethics. The CARE principles are used when collecting data from or about indigenous people to
ensure fair and ethical practices that do not echo the mistakes of the past. These provide emphasis on the consent of indigenous people to give data (and avoiding stealing
with an area for collective benefit and that they be informed about your use of it.
